[[File:Shayzien symbol.png|left|120px]]
'''Shayzien''' is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of [[Great Kourend]]. Led by [[Lord Shiro Shayzien]] of the Shayzien House, the city controls the [[Shayzien Army]], the main military force providing law, order, and defence for the kingdom.

Most Shayzien citizens are part of the Army, and serve as the police force responsible for dealing with crime in Great Kourend, as well as defending the kingdom against the [[Lizardman|lizardmen]], creatures created by [[Xeric]], a powerful mage who reigned over Great Kourend in the past.

Shayzien is one of the more recent cities founded in the history of Great Kourend; it was founded by the legendary heroine [[Camorra Shayzien]] during the [[Dragonkin Conflicts]] 2,000 years ago.{{CiteText|text=Tomb (Dragon Slayer II)|quote=Here lies Camorra Shayzien // Founder of Shayzien House.}}

==Transportation==
*[[Xeric's talisman]] - Use the [[Xeric's Lookout]] teleport
*[[Fairy rings]] - Use the code {{Fairycode|DJR}} and then run south-east
*[[Skills necklace]] - Use the Woodcutting Guild teleport and walk west until you reach the War Tent and then walk north
*[[Kourend Castle Teleport]] and then run south-west
*[[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]] - Use [[History and Hearsay]] to teleport to the Graveyard of Heroes (requires completion of [[Tale of the Righteous]])

==Features==
===Shayzien Administration===
[[File:Shayzien Administration.png|The Shayzien Administration building.|thumb|300px]]
The [[Shayzien Administration]] is a government building from which the city is run, though it also contains living quarters for soldiers. [[Commissioner Anwar]], who is in charge of the Shayzien Constabulary, assists [[Lord Shiro Shayzien]] with the day-to-day operations of the city and the ongoing war with the [[lizardmen]] in the [[Shayzien Encampment]].

The recruitment office is also located here. [[Captain Bruce]], a recruitment officer, manages recruitment efforts.

===Shayzien bank===
{{main|Shayzien bank}}

===Giant Pit===
{{main|Giant Pit}}
The '''Giant Pit''' is a small enclosure found north-west of [[Shayzien]]. It is occupied by 13 [[Hill Giant]]s, and commonly used by players to farm for the [[giant champion scroll]].

===Graveyard of Heroes===
{{main|Graveyard of Heroes}}
The Graveyard of Heroes, where fallen soldiers of the [[Shayzien Army]] are commemorated in the form of ceremonial pillars, comprise nearly half of the city's space. The local church can be found here with an altar.

The entrance to the [[Shayzien Crypts]] can be found here.

===Shayzien Crypts===
{{main|Shayzien Crypts}}
The Shayzien Crypts is the ancient burial site for Shayzien's heroes and Kourend royalty, found in the [[Graveyard of Heroes]]. The founder of the Shayzien House, [[Camorra Shayzien]], is buried here. The crypts been overrun by powerful undead for the past several hundred years, with efforts to clear them out unsuccessful, so trips into the crypts are seldom carried out.

===Shayzien Prison===
{{main|Shayzien Prison}}
The Shayzien Prison is an underground prison for Kourend's criminals, found just outside of the city walls. It is visited during the quest [[A Kingdom Divided]].

===Xeric's Lookout===
{{main|Xeric's Lookout}}
An old, abandoned tower found just south-east of the city, it is not often visited due to its association with [[Xeric]]. [[Xeric's talisman]] can teleport players here.

===Notable homes===
[[File:Shayzien entrance.png|thumb|300px|The north-western entrance to Shayzien.]]
Players visit the homes of various NPCs as part of a quest:
* [[Phileas Rimor]]'s house is found next to [[The Cloak and Stagger]] tavern.
* [[Shayda]]'s house is found just south of the Shayzien Administration building.
* [[Amelia]]'s house is found next to Shayda's.

==Favour (historical)==
Prior to [[Update:Children of the Sun|an update]] on [[10 January]] [[2024]], [[favour]] was a core mechanic of each city on [[Kourend]]. Historical information about how favour was gained and its benefits are documented [[Shayzien/Historical|here]].

==Trivia==
*Shayzien was named after Mod Reach's beloved cat, Shay, who was "a fucking warrior" for going through a difficult surgery, and associating it with Asian warriors such as samurai.{{CiteGeneral|url=https://clips.twitch.tv/KnottyIncredulousChowderPanicVis|title=Origin of the name Shayzien|author=Dan|date=29 January 2020}} A tribute to Shay - the [[Cat Shrine]] - can be found upstairs in a house within the city.

===QR code easter egg===
Throughout the Shayzien area, there are four out-of-place mysterious tiles found in less-travelled areas of Shayzien.

{|class=wikitable style="text-align:center;"
! colspan=4|Locations
|-
|{{Map|caption=Shayzia Ruin|x=1592|y=3588|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250}}
|{{Map|caption=West of the Chasm of Fire|x=1413|y=3658|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250}}
|{{Map|caption=Southern end of Shayziens' Wall|x=1407|y=3490|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250}}
|{{Map|caption=South of Xeric's Lookout|x=1588|y=3511|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250}}
|-
! colspan=4|Tile
|-
|[[File:Shayzien QR code tile 1.png|250px]]
|[[File:Shayzien QR code tile 2.png|250px]]
|[[File:Shayzien QR code tile 3.png|250px]]
|[[File:Shayzien QR code tile 4.png|250px]]
|}
These are in fact four parts of a QR code that must be assembled together through image editing software, merging the dark parts together and colouring the tiles white. If assembled correctly, the resulting image can be scanned using a code scanner app on a phone or website.
[[File:Shayzien QR code tiles assembled.png|thumb|300px|The correctly assembled QR code.]]

Scanning the code will result in the output "@OldpackAvailers", which is a Twitter handle with the name "Archibald Paldock", the name of the [[Odd Old Man]]. These tiles were originally added into the game files with [[Fossil Island]] in 2017, but were never visible outside of datamining software; the Odd Old Man plays a role in [[Bone Voyage]], which is required to reach Fossil Island. In addition, "OldpackAvailers" is an anagram for "Paldock Silvarea" ([[Silvarea]] is a winding mountain pass north-east of [[Varrock]].)

The only tweet from the account, dated 4 January 2019 (the 18th anniversary of ''RuneScape''), is as follows:
{{Cquote2|0000 1 1 0110 111000 10010 10010 1000 00 1 010101 0100 1011 10010 0110 01 0100 100 111 1010 101|@OldpackAvailers}}

The tweet in actuality is disguised as {{WP|Morse code}}, which is known to be featured in a number of easter eggs implemented by [[Mod West]]. To convert it, the zeros are to be substituted with periods, and ones substituted with dashes, as seen below.
{{Cquote2|.... - - .--. ---... -..-. -..-. -... .. - .-.-.- .-.. -.-- -..-. .--. .- .-.. -.. --- -.-. -.-}}

Converting the Morse code text will result in the output <nowiki>http://bit.ly/paldock</nowiki>, a shortened link from {{WP|Bitly}}, a URL shortening service. When the link is accessed, it redirects players to a YouTube video of Rick Astley's hit song, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ Never Gonna Give You Up]. Such an act is known as {{WP|Rickrolling}}, a famous Internet prank.
